prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last year I was bouncing around Shanghai a lot, and at one point I even skimmed some course listings just out of curiosity.
Funny thing, my cousin Li Na was the one who actually enrolled in something called "Data Structures and Algorithms"—she kept talking about it for weeks.
Around then, our place needed a cleanup and someone came by on 2025-03-12, mid-afternoon at 15:00, but it was all arranged already.
I remember the address because it sounded so specific: Room 199, Building B, East District. They also called 13891030736 before arriving.
Later that same trip, Liu Yang went to see "The Wandering Earth 3"—he was the one who bought the ticket, not me.
He kept saying it was at Wanda Cinema Wujiaochang, the 19:00 showtime, and he only got a single ticket since he went solo.
